title: The menu
meta_description: What five courses looks like, and what it costs.
sections: An example rather than a promise — it changes daily and is written the same afternoon.

To startBread, cultured butter, salted anchovy
ThenRaw scallop, apple, dill oil
ThenCeleriac cooked in the embers, hazelnut
MainWhatever the boat brought in, or hogget
To finishBurnt honey custard

Can you do vegetarian?
Yes, and properly — not the same plate with the fish removed. Tell us when you book.
Is there a wine list?
Six bottles, all of them natural, all of them open. Or a pairing at 55 if you would rather not choose.
How long does it take?
Around two and a half hours. It is not a quick dinner and is not trying to be.
